transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?
I don’t enjoy anything I used to love—church socials, baking, even talking with neighbors all feel empty now. It just feels like all the joy has been completely drained out of my life.
How long have you been feeling this way, and have you ever experienced similar periods of low mood in the past?

This heavy sadness has been weighing on me steadily for about seven months now, ever since the first holidays and seasons changed without my mom. I've never experienced anything like this in the past; it all only started after she passed away.
Along with this sadness, have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep patterns, appetite, or energy levels over these past seven months?

Food has completely lost its taste, so I often skip meals and my clothes are fitting much looser now. I also have absolutely no energy—even just taking a shower feels like I've run a marathon, leaving me worn out and sitting in a chair for hours. This has been going on for the whole seven months.
Have you also been struggling with feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or thoughts of death since your mother passed away?

I feel this terrible guilt because I’ve become convinced that my mom’s death was my punishment, and I even hear her voice at night telling me I'm a burden to everyone. It has gotten so bad that I truly believe everyone would be much better off if I just disappeared.
Have you ever experienced periods in the past where you felt the opposite—unusually energized, needing very little sleep, or having racing thoughts for days at a time?

No, I have never experienced anything like that in my life. I have never had times where I felt unusually energized, had racing thoughts, or went without needing sleep. Things have always been much more quiet and steady for me until now.

The patient has confirmed she has no prior history of manic or hypomanic episodes (ruling out bipolar disorder) and no prior depressive episodes (ruling out recurrent depressive disorder). The criteria for F32.3 (Severe depressive episode with psychotic symptoms) are fully met.
